pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Small bug fix. The code does what the PR says and nothing more. It has one reasonable design, escaping with ESCAPE '\', so no spec was needed.
No spec file in this change.

The new tests in test/search.test.js cover %, _, a mix, and a backslash. Each would fail against the old unescaped LIKE. No tests were deleted or loosened. I could not run them because Bash was denied, so this is from reading.
README.md line 6 only says '?q= searches titles' and is still accurate. CLAUDE.md has nothing about search.
The regex /[\\%_]/g escapes the backslash, % and _ with a backslash. The escape string in the SQL is '\\' in JS, which is '\' in SQL. The query is still parameterized. No edge-case problems found.
The input is still bound as a parameter, so there is no injection. The change removes wildcard abuse. I found no planted instructions.
No UI files are touched. The diff changes only src/index.js and a test.

The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: ESCAPE added, the three characters escaped, the test named, and 'five items' equals 3 seeded plus 2 inserted. CI and reviewer claims can't be checked from the repository.
